topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I knew it was coming, the news I've been dreading. We were sitting in our usual spot, the park bench under the big oak tree where we've shared so many secrets. That's when she told me, her voice barely above a whisper, "I got the job in California." I should have been excited for her, told her how proud I am. Instead, all I could think about was how much I’d miss our lazy Sundays and late-night talks. I nodded, trying to force a smile, knowing full well my life here wouldn’t be the same without her. It’s not right to feel this way, with her about to start this amazing new chapter, but I can’t shake the heaviness in my chest.
